itinerary: 08:00 – 09:00 AM | Seamless Port Pickup: We will meet you promptly between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM at Chân Mây Port. For your convenience, you may choose either 1. Pickup inside the port or 2. Pickup just outside the port gate.
Arrival & Imperial Discovery: After an approximately one-hour scenic drive, we arrive at the heart of Hue and immediately dive into the city’s majestic past.
Khai Dinh Royal Tomb: Begin your exploration at this visually stunning royal resting place, famous for its unique blend of distinctive Western and Eastern architectural styles.

The Imperial Citadel: Step inside the ancient capital of Vietnam, a UNESCO World Heritage Site built by Emperor Gia Long in 1805. This powerful complex was the center of the Nguyễn Dynasty. You will explore numerous ramparts, palaces, and royal structures that remain nearly origi
Lunch & Relaxation: Enjoy a delicious lunch at a famous local garden restaurant, providing a refreshing culinary experience and a short, peaceful rest before continuing your journey.

Thien Mu Pagoda – The Spiritual Icon: Our afternoon starts at the oldest and most beautiful pagoda in Hue. Located just 3km from the Citadel on the northern bank of the Perfume River, Thien Mu Pagoda offers a tranquil atmosphere surrounded by ornamental plants. In the late aftern

Safe Return to Port: Following your spiritual visit, we will commence the drive back. You are guaranteed to arrive at the port at least one and a half hours before your ship's departure time, ensuring a safe and stress-free return.
Tour Conclusion: The full-day historical experience concludes back at your Cruise ship, typically around 4:00 PM.
